label: Diagram 3.10
caption: Diagram 3.10 External protection to protected stairways | External escape stairs
description: The drawing is a cross-section elevation titled "Configurations of stairs and external wall", with "See para 3.66" at the top left and "Diagram 3.10 External protection to protected stairways" in a green band along the bottom. It presents two alternative sections side by side, "Configuration A" on the left and "Configuration B" on the right. Each shows a "Stair" drawn with vertical step lines between two storeys labelled "Accommodation". A legend on the right defines three fills: dark green, "Fire resisting construction of adjacent building enclosure"; light green, "Fire resisting construction of protected stairway"; and white, "Non-fire resisting construction". In Configuration A the upper accommodation's right-hand wall is dark green, with a vertical dimension "1800mm min." beside it and a horizontal dimension "1800mm min." to the right of the stair; the stair enclosure is shown in light green. In Configuration B the upper right-hand wall is white, and only the horizontal "1800mm min." dimension is shown beside the stair.

notes: The description mentions dark green only for "the upper accommodation's right-hand wall" in Configuration A, but the drawing also shows a dark green horizontal line at the top of the lower "Accommodation" (fire resisting construction of the adjacent building enclosure) extending to the right of the stair in both Configuration A and Configuration B.
